intro: Big Bad Brain Wrestling: the physics of fake pain and the economy of real ego.
outro: My brain is back next week anyway. It's still real to me, dammit.

lines.opener: Every morning my brain climbs out of bed as
lines.triplet: The Babyface, high-flying moves, because audiences cheer: a slave to approval.

lines.opener: Nobody cheers for me, so I become
lines.triplet: The Heel: bear hugs, eye pokes. If they aren't booing, you aren't doing your job.

lines.opener: Now my brain doesn't even ask for applause.
lines.triplet: The Tweener: you don't ask for it, which makes them want you more.

lines.opener: Guess who's lying on the kitchen floor?
lines.triplet: The Jobber, isolated and picked apart. You exist to make the other guy look good.

lines.opener: I try to get up; my brain sits on me.
lines.triplet: The Immovable Object, slow gorilla, strong enough to hurl you like a ragdoll.

lines.opener: So I climb the bookshelf.
lines.triplet: The Aerial Ace, agile and fast: if you stand still, you die.

lines.opener: My brain jumps after me.
lines.triplet: The Powerhouse Botch off the top rope: a tragedy waiting to happen.

lines.opener: Out of nowhere I lift my own brain over my head.
lines.triplet: The Little Giant: smaller, surprising strength.

lines.opener: For days I limp through the flat.
lines.triplet: The Master Seller: reel back, limp to the ring, make them believe.

lines.opener: My brain doesn't buy it.
lines.triplet: The No-Sell Monster sits right back up: remove all tension for ego.

lines.opener: So I kick the wardrobe and slap my leg.
lines.triplet: The Thigh Slap didn't hurt, but it sounds like it did. An audio lie.

lines.opener: My neighbour bangs on the wall; it's only my chest.
lines.triplet: The Echo Chest: loud noise, but it requires many strikes to actually bruise.

lines.opener: So we go on all night, chop for chop.
lines.triplet: The Chop Fest: nothing but chop, until one quits. A test of endurance.

lines.opener: At breakfast my brain turns up in a mask.
lines.triplet: The Sacred Mask, sacred to identity: never remove it.

lines.opener: I rip it off anyway.
lines.triplet: The Rudo Ripper: instant disqualification, but you win the feud.

lines.opener: Next morning my brain won't shake my hand.
lines.triplet: The Limp Arm: rejection of the traditional start, a telltale sign of a shooter.

lines.opener: To feel anything at all, I cut myself shaving. On purpose.
lines.triplet: The Juice Lover: you can't hurt me if I hurt me first.

lines.opener: My brain answers with a sports bag on the table.
lines.triplet: The Snake Bag has a live snake: terrify them before the match starts.

lines.opener: So I stay in bed all day:
lines.triplet: The Lazy Genius, hands in pockets. It looks like a chore, and the apathy makes them furious.

lines.opener: Furious, my brain puts on a feather boa and goes for my dignity.
lines.triplet: The Exotic: dignity rather than body. Psychological dominance.

lines.opener: I tag in my liver.
lines.triplet: The Hot Tag: fresh partner for payback, the explosive release of tension.

lines.opener: My liver lasts a minute.
lines.triplet: The Victim, isolated and picked apart: you are the bait.

lines.opener: My brain calls in my nerves.
lines.triplet: The Wolfpack: triple attack on an isolated target. The numbers game.

lines.opener: Now a little voice in my head tells everyone what to do.
lines.triplet: The Savant Manager: you know the moves better than they do.

lines.opener: I ask the cat what she wants to see.
lines.triplet: The Pop Hunter: if they want a heel, give them a heel. If they want a clown, honk your nose.

lines.opener: The cat walks out.
lines.triplet: The Empty Arena, pausing for a pop that never comes: silence amplifies the sound of impacts.

lines.opener: So I play cat videos at full volume.
lines.triplet: The Green Screen Crowd: a failed attempt to hide the emptiness.

lines.opener: The cat comes back in a fake moustache and bets on my brain.
lines.triplet: The Plant: I'm just a fan! Gambling on the outcome while part of the show.

lines.opener: That's when my brain stops playing along.
lines.triplet: The Shooter: if you refuse to sell, real damage.

lines.opener: Something in my head goes crack.
lines.triplet: The Real Injury, unplanned. The crowd goes nuts because it's real.

lines.opener: That night it comes back from the cellar in a long black coat.
lines.triplet: The Undead Wizard: get under their skin with smoke and mirrors.

lines.opener: My brain pokes me once, with one finger.
lines.triplet: The Finger Poke: a test of strength? No, a test of gullibility.

lines.opener: I've saved one move for this.
lines.triplet: The Finisher, the Leg Drop: if this hits, go home.

lines.opener: It hits. My brain kicks out.
lines.triplet: The False Finish: the art of the near-fall.

lines.opener: Round two is over before I can sit up.
lines.triplet: The Squash: total dominance.

lines.opener: By midnight we both lie there, staring at the ceiling.
lines.triplet: The Time Limit Draw: no winner, both keep their dignity.

lines.opener: So who decides who wins in my head?
lines.triplet: The Booker: the ending is pre-planned. You are just a puppet.

lines.opener: I charge, my brain steps aside, and I meet the radiator.
lines.triplet: The Ring Post, unforgiving steel: the hardest object in the building.

lines.opener: My neighbour filmed the whole thing through the window.
lines.triplet: The Hard Cam: if the camera didn't see it, it didn't happen.

lines.opener: Then he posted a review.
lines.triplet: The Internet Smark, talking about psychology without ever taking a bump.

lines.opener: When the doctor asks what happened, I say nothing.
lines.triplet: The Kayfabe Police: keep the secrets secret, or get fired.

lines.opener: So I lose on purpose.
lines.triplet: The Retirement Match: rising, and falling. See you next season.
